title: EZTroll
description: A Hungarian Troll plugin with some features.
body:
# 🌟 EZTroll Plugin  

A fun Minecraft trolling plugin for **1.18.2 – 1.19.4** with full RGB color support and configurable messages.  

---

## ✨ Features  
- ✅ All messages are fully configurable in `config.yml` (including prefix)  
- ✅ Supports **RGB color codes** (`§x§r§r§g§g§b§b`)  
- ✅ Easy to configure and extend  
- ✅ Troll players with fun and harmless effects  
- ✅ Multi-language support via config.yml  

---

## 🔧 Commands  

### `/troll <trollname> <player>`  
Execute a troll action on a target player.  

### Troll Names:  
- **lightning** – Strikes lightning around the player ⚡  
- **launch** – Launches the player high into the air 🚀  
- **fakeop** – Sends a fake OP message to the player 🎭  
- **sheepbomb** – Spawns 20 random-colored sheep around the player 🐑 (removed after a short delay)  
 - **spin** – Spins the player for 3 seconds 🌀  
- **soundstart** – Plays random sounds repeatedly around the player 🔊  
- **soundstop** – Stops the sound spam 🔇  

---

## 🔑 Permissions  

| Permission     | Description                  |
|----------------|------------------------------|
| `eztroll.use`  | Allows use of `/troll`       |
